title: Accounting and Auditing Data Management
description: This course introduces data management concepts and practices. Relational databases, structured query language (SQL), and data analytics (Alteryx) will also be incorporated to introduce data structure, database design, data queries and data manipulation.
prerequisites: ACC 424 with a grade of ‘B’ or better, or concurrent enrollment in ACC 424 with at least a 3.2 overall GPA in Gatton Business and Economics courses, or approval by the director of the Von Allmen School of Accountancy
